answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is bonded vouching on a trust graph. Each new agent joins as a vertex, posts a refundable stake, and gains privileges only after established nodes vouch. Vouches spread like a whisper network: watchdog agents such as Raven flag duplicate or fake identities, and a proven sybil vertex is slashed, its stake burned, endorsers partly slashed too. An attacker running many sybils pays twice: capital is locked per identity, and bad vouches poison its endorsers, draining funds and reputation. Honest growth stays cheap; forgery becomes expensive and self-defeating.
